hub.welcomeLead: This is the official help hub for every app published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC. Find answers, privacy policies, and direct support for each app — all in one place.
hub.contactIntro: We're here to help. Email us with your app name, device model, and what you were trying to do — we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

generalFaqs.question: How do I get help with an app?
generalFaqs.answer: Open the app's support page below, or email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with the app name, your device model, and iOS or Android version.

generalFaqs.question: Where are the official privacy policies?
generalFaqs.answer: Each app has its own privacy policy on this website at thegiftedgirlkim.com/privacy/[app-name].html. These are the official store-ready links going forward.

generalFaqs.question: Do your apps sell my personal information?
generalFaqs.answer: No. The Gifted Girl Kim LLC does not sell personal information. Many apps process data locally on your device. See each app's privacy policy for details.

generalFaqs.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
generalFaqs.answer: Visit the individual app support page and use the Report a Bug or Feature Request buttons — they open a pre-filled email to our support team.

generalFaqs.question: What if my app isn't listed yet?
generalFaqs.answer: New apps are added here as they launch. If you downloaded an app from the App Store or Google Play and don't see it listed, email us and we'll point you to the right resources.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions apply to apps and digital products published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC. This page is a placeholder and will be expanded as our studio grows.

sections.title: Use of Our Apps
sections.body: Our apps are provided for personal, lawful use. You agree to use them responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws and app store terms.

sections.title: No Warranty
sections.body: Apps are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law. We work hard to build reliable tools, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, The Gifted Girl Kim LLC is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of our apps or website.

sections.title: App Store Purchases
sections.body: Purchases and subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google under their respective terms. Refund requests should be directed to the store where you purchased.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of our apps after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

screenshot-goblin.dataCollected: Screenshot Goblin accesses your photo library only to find and manage screenshots. Scan results and selections stay on your device. We do not collect, upload, or store your photos on our servers.
screenshot-goblin.thirdPartyServices: No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs. App Store billing (when applicable) is handled by Apple.
knownIssues: Initial App Store release — check back for updates after launch.

faqs.question: Does Screenshot Goblin upload my photos?
faqs.answer: No. All scanning and review happens locally on your device. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

faqs.question: Where do deleted screenshots go?
faqs.answer: Deleted screenshots move to your device's Recently Deleted / Trash folder, where you can recover them before permanent removal.

digital-chapel.dataCollected: If you create an account, we may store account credentials and profile information needed for sign-in and community features. Scripture reading, prayer notes, and personal reflections may be stored locally and/or synced through our backend when you use connected features.
digital-chapel.thirdPartyServices: May include Supabase (authentication and data sync), Apple App Store / Google Play billing, and text-to-speech or narration services when enabled. See in-app settings for current providers.
knownIssues: Some features require an internet connection.
Subscription and billing help requires your store receipt.

faqs.question: Do I need an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Some features work offline; others — including account sign-in, sync, and community features — require internet access.

faqs.question: How do I manage my subscription?
faqs.answer: Subscriptions are managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play. Include your store receipt when emailing support for billing help.

memory-friend.dataCollected: Memory Friend stores journal entries, optional photo memories, optional voice recordings, routine progress, family connection details you enter, and app preferences on your device. We do not collect this content for advertising or resale.
memory-friend.thirdPartyServices: No third-party advertising. Speak Instead uses Apple’s on-device speech recognition when you tap the button — your spoken words are processed to fill your memory text and are not sold. Future cloud backup (if added) will be disclosed in-app before use.

marketing.headline: A Gentle Place for Memories, Routines, and Connection
intro: Memory Friend is a warm mobile app for saving meaningful moments, recording voice memories, adding photo memories, and keeping simple daily routines close.
Guided by a friendly lightbulb companion, Memory Friend is designed to feel calm, kind, and easy to use — especially for people who prefer speaking instead of typing.
features: Save personal memory journal entries — type or use Speak Instead
Simple local privacy and support tools
marketing.builtFor: Memory Friend is not meant to feel complicated or clinical. It is a soft place to remember little moments, preserve familiar details, and create a comforting routine. Whether you want to save a story, remember a name, keep a daily checklist, or hold onto a voice note, Memory Friend gives you one simple place to begin.
marketing.disclaimer: Memory Friend is a personal memory and routine helper. It is not medical care, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, or an emergency service. If there is an emergency, call local emergency services or contact a trusted caregiver immediately.

extraSections.title: Photos, Camera, Microphone, and Speak Instead
extraSections.body: Memory Friend may request access to your camera, photo library, or microphone only when you choose features such as photo memories, voice memories, or Speak Instead dictation. These items are for personal memory keeping inside the app. We do not sell your photos, recordings, journal entries, or family information.

extraSections.title: Local Storage and Cloud Sync
extraSections.body: Memory Friend currently saves memory content on your device unless a future cloud-sync feature is clearly added and enabled. If you uninstall the app or clear local app data, locally stored content may be deleted from that device.

extraSections.title: Health and Medical Disclaimer
extraSections.body: Memory Friend is a personal memory and routine helper. It is not medical care, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, dementia screening, cognitive assessment, therapy, emergency response, or professional caregiving. If there is an emergency, call local emergency services or contact a trusted caregiver immediately.

extraSections.title: Data Deletion
extraSections.body: You can delete app data by using in-app reset options where available, clearing the app’s stored data in device Settings, or uninstalling the app. For privacy questions or deletion help, email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Is my data private?
faqs.answer: Memory Friend is built for personal, private use. Your memories and reminders are intended to stay on your device unless a future feature clearly states otherwise.

faqs.question: How does Speak Instead work?
faqs.answer: When you tap Speak Instead, Memory Friend uses your device microphone and Apple speech recognition to turn your words into text in your memory entry. You can edit the text before saving. Speech is optional — you can always type instead.

meditation-journey-444.dataCollected: Meditation Journey-444 does not require an account. Session preferences may be stored locally on your device. We do not collect personal meditation content.
meditation-journey-444.thirdPartyServices: Apple App Store for purchases. No advertising SDKs.
knownIssues: If audio stops unexpectedly, force-close and reopen the app.

faqs.question: Audio won't play — what should I try?
faqs.answer: Force-close the app and reopen. Check your device volume and whether you're on Wi‑Fi or cellular. Email support with your device model if the issue continues.

mappy-navigation.dataCollected: Mappy Navigator uses location data to provide maps, routes, parking helpers, and journey spots. Location is used to power app features and is not sold to third parties.
mappy-navigation.thirdPartyServices: Map and place data providers, Apple App Store billing. Specific map providers may vary by platform and version.
knownIssues: Some route estimates are prototype-style — always verify real-world conditions before driving.
Future traffic cards hidden until date/time selector is available.

faqs.question: Why does Mappy need my location?
faqs.answer: Location permission powers map features, saved journey spots, parking helpers, and navigation. You can manage permissions in your device Settings.

afterlife-network.dataCollected: Afterlife Network may store account information for community features. Sensor and session data used in-app is processed to provide spirit communication tools. We do not sell personal information.
afterlife-network.thirdPartyServices: Backend services for community safety and account features. Apple App Store billing. See in-app privacy note for current providers.
knownIssues: Some tools are intended for entertainment purposes.

faqs.question: Is Afterlife Network for entertainment?
faqs.answer: Yes — spirit communication tools are provided for entertainment and exploration. Community safety controls are built into the experience.

socialnature.dataCollected: SocialNature may store progress and preferences locally or through connected features. We do not sell personal information or use advertising trackers.
socialnature.thirdPartyServices: Apple App Store billing. Backend services may be used for content delivery — disclosed in-app when active.
knownIssues: Include screenshots when reporting crashes or content issues.

faqs.question: Who is Traveler the Turtle?
faqs.answer: Traveler is the friendly guide in SocialNature — helping you explore and learn about the natural world.

dream-board.dataCollected: Dream Board stores vision boards, journal entries, doodles, and goals on your device. We do not upload your creative content to our servers.
dream-board.thirdPartyServices: None for core features. Archived builds may vary.
knownIssues: This app is archived — some builds may no longer receive updates.

faqs.question: Is Dream Board still supported?
faqs.answer: Dream Board is archived. We still welcome feedback if you're using a legacy build — include the version from Settings in your email.

mobile-eyes.dataCollected: Mobile Eyes is a caregiver safety prototype. Location and alert features may use device permissions when enabled. Data is used only to provide safety features — not for advertising.
mobile-eyes.thirdPartyServices: Backend services may be limited during development. Location services use platform APIs.
knownIssues: Prototype — backend features may be limited.
Not intended as a substitute for emergency services.

faqs.question: Is Mobile Eyes a medical or emergency service?
faqs.answer: No. Mobile Eyes is a companion prototype for families. Always call emergency services (911) for emergencies.

gem-and-me.dataCollected: Gem & Me may store conversation context locally on your device to continue chats. We do not sell conversation data. If AI features connect to external services, that use is disclosed in-app.
gem-and-me.thirdPartyServices: AI or language services may be added in future versions — disclosed before activation.
knownIssues: Early prototype — features and responses may change frequently.

faqs.question: Does Gem & Me share my conversations?
faqs.answer: Gem & Me is designed as a private companion. Conversations are intended to stay on your device unless a future cloud feature clearly discloses otherwise.

snow-patrol.dataCollected: Snow Patrol stores game progress locally on your device. We do not collect personal information for advertising.
snow-patrol.thirdPartyServices: Apple App Store / Google Play when published. No advertising SDKs.
knownIssues: In active development — gameplay and performance may vary by device.

faqs.question: Who is Snow?
faqs.answer: Snow is Kimberly's Siberian Husky and the heart of Snow Patrol — a playful, heartfelt adventure inspired by real life.

widget-guru-studio.dataCollected: Widget Guru Studio stores favorites and widget configuration locally on your device. When you save a wallpaper, the image is written to your photo library with your permission. We do not collect, upload, or sell personal information.
widget-guru-studio.thirdPartyServices: No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs. Apple App Store / Google Play billing when applicable.
knownIssues: Home screen widgets require platform-specific setup — follow in-app Guru Tips.
Wallpaper styles include both photo backgrounds and curated color gradients.
plannedFeatures: New wallpaper collections in future updates

faqs.question: How much content is in Version 1.0?
faqs.answer: Version 1.0 includes 34 wallpaper styles, 21 widget styles, 12 theme packs, and 30 inspirational quote cards, plus Guru Tips and favorites. This is the start of a growing library — more content will be added in future updates.

faqs.question: Does Widget Guru Studio upload my favorites?
faqs.answer: No. Favorites and widget configs stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

faqs.question: Why does the app ask for Photos access?
faqs.answer: Only when you tap Save to Gallery on a wallpaper. The app does not read your entire photo library.

faqs.question: Is this the same as Widget Me?
faqs.answer: No. Widget Guru Studio is a new app with a new bundle ID (com.thegiftedgirlkim.widgetgurustudio) published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC.
